    For the final round of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12, TV coverage is on CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET. Early coverage is available on Paramount+, and Featured Groups can be watched on Masters Live. 
    Final Round Coverage (Sunday, April 12): 
    • TV Channel: CBS (2:00 PM – 7:00 PM ET)
    • Streaming: Paramount+, Masters.com, and the Masters App
    • Featured Groups (Streaming): Masters Live, ESPN App, Prime Video, Paramount+, DirecTV, and Masters App
    • Amen Corner (Streaming): Masters Live, Prime Video, Paramount+, and Masters App 
    Note: Times and channels are based on the 2026 schedule.
